name: Dreame robot vacuums
description: Every robot vacuum on your Dreamehome account.
author: LocalAssistant

connection.description: Sign in with the account the Dreamehome app uses. The password is stored encrypted. Dreame may refuse anything but its own app.
connection.connected: Robots are read every two minutes.

fields.name: restartWhenStuck
fields.label: Restart when stuck
fields.description: Dreame robots sometimes say they're stuck when they aren't. Tell them to carry on, up to twice per clean, and say so in the notification.
